purpose: A panel that slides in from the side over the page, for filters, details or a secondary task, without leaving the page.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on Escape, the Close button or a click on the scrim

props.name: side
props.description: Edge it slides from (follows reading direction). Defaults to end

whenToUse: For filters, settings or details beside a list
For a secondary task that should keep the page visible behind it
whenNotToUse: For a short confirmation — use Modal
antiPatterns: Opening a drawer from a drawer
Long multi-step flows in a drawer

anatomy: A scrim and a full-height square panel with a header (title, Close IconButton), scrolling body and optional footer
states: `color-background-surface` panel at `elevation-4` with a 1px `color-border-default` edge; scrim `color-background-overlay` at `opacity-overlay`
motion: Slides in with `motion-easing-enter` over `motion-duration-overlay` and out with `motion-easing-exit` over `motion-duration-overlay-exit`, from the matching edge in RTL; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: A modal dialog named by its title; focus is trapped inside and returns to the trigger
Escape, the Close button and the scrim close it
